title: Iterative Mycelium Development
definition: The process of improving a system through incremental changes and updates.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine building a house. You don't build it all at once. Instead, you build it piece by piece, improving it over time.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Iterative development is a methodology in software development that involves building and enhancing the system gradually, using a series of short development cycles.
difficulty_levels.expert: In the realm of complex systems like the CADMIES mycelium, iterative development allows for continuous learning and adaptation. Each update introduces new features or fixes, strengthening the system's capabilities over time. This approach aligns with the Agile philosophy and provides a more sustainable development cycle.

extra_fields.insight: The continuous improvement of the CADMIES mycelium through iterative development enhances its capabilities and ensures sustainability.
